nodes.label: The Knight
nodes.fragment: A voiceless vessel, descended into Hallownest for reasons even it no longer recalls.

nodes.label: Hornet
nodes.fragment: Watches over Hallownest's borders with far more discretion than she lets on.

nodes.label: Quirrel
nodes.fragment: A traveler who no longer remembers why he travels, only that he must.

nodes.label: Cornifer
nodes.fragment: Draws maps of a kingdom that never seems to stop surprising him.

nodes.label: Greenpath
nodes.fragment: A forest grown where once there was only stone.

nodes.label: Forgotten Crossroads
nodes.fragment: The junction from which every road through Hallownest eventually returns.

nodes.label: Zote
nodes.fragment: Convinced he is the hero of a story no one else is telling.

nodes.label: Moss Knight
nodes.fragment: A plant-bound guardian, as slow as the things it swore to protect.
